author: Jason Stys
summary: Bind consumer acknowledgements to secret generations and inspect drain/expiry/replay queues; patch the actual OpenBao build and fail closed for its unused incompatible Okta integration.
rationale: Makes rotation completion evidence explicit and removes known dependency risks without pretending unsupported authentication still works.
limitations: Pool-drain acknowledgements and consumer codes are in-process assertions, not authentication or proof of server acceptance.
Local overlap is a lease-time calculation, not a zero-downtime guarantee.
The unused incompatible Okta integration fails closed; this project does not claim working Okta authentication.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
